tools.description: Show test cases added or removed between two test-plan files or refs. Provide either two file paths (basePath / headPath) or two git refs (baseRef / headRef) and a common filePath.

basePath.description: Base test-plan file path (relative to repo root)

headPath.description: Head test-plan file path (relative to repo root)

filePath.description: File path relative to repo root, used when baseRef/headRef are provided

tools.name: testplan_extract
tools.description: Extract structured test cases from a PR body or a test-plan file. Provide either pr (GitHub PR number) or path (local file path) — not both.

pr.description: GitHub PR number to read the body from

path.description: Local test-plan file path (relative to repo root or absolute), e.g. "docs/test-plans/LS-1234.md"

servers.label: Android
servers.summary: Android device/emulator connectivity, app install/launch, adb-backed screenshots, filtered logcat, and Gradle builds. Local-only — no SDK in any cloud agent environment.

tools.name: android_app
tools.description: Install or launch the app on a connected Android device/emulator. action="install" wraps `adb install`. action="launch" force-stops (default) then wraps `adb shell am start`. Call android_device({ action: "list" }) first to confirm a device is online.

apkPath.description: action="install" only (required). Path to the .apk to install.

reinstall.description: action="install" only. Pass -r to adb install (keep app data).

allowDowngrade.description: action="install" only. Pass -d to allow a versionCode downgrade (avoids INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE).

forceStop.description: action="launch" only. Force-stop the app before starting it, clearing prior in-memory state.

serial.description: Target a specific device (adb -s). Defaults to the sole online device.

tools.name: android_build
tools.description: Build the Android app via Gradle (wraps `gradlew app:assembleDebug`/`app:assembleRelease`). Sets a fresh GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER-shaped versionCode automatically (current epoch seconds) so a local build reinstalling over a device with a newer CI build does not hit INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE — pass versionCode to pin a specific value instead.

arch.description: Restrict the native build to one ABI via -PreactNativeArchitectures, e.g. "x86_64" for a faster emulator-only build.

versionCode.description: Pin GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER (and therefore the Gradle versionCode) to this value instead of the auto-generated epoch-seconds default.

tools.name: android_device
tools.description: Android device/emulator connectivity. Resolves the SDK path itself (ANDROID_HOME/ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/default install dir) — never export PATH by hand. action="list" wraps `adb devices`. action="start_emulator" boots an AVD and blocks on sys.boot_completed (up to ~45s per call — re-call to keep waiting, it never spawns a second emulator while one is already booting); no-ops if a device is already connected. action="reverse" wraps `adb reverse` to point a device at a local Metro dev server.

avd.description: action="start_emulator" only. AVD name to boot. Defaults to $ANDROID_AVD, then the only installed AVD.

waitForBoot.description: action="start_emulator" only. Block until sys.boot_completed=1 (bounded per call — see description). Pass false to just kick off the boot.

timeoutMs.description: action="start_emulator" only. Per-call boot-wait budget in ms (default 45000). Cold boot can take minutes — re-call to keep waiting.

devicePort.description: action="reverse" only. Port on the device to forward.

hostPort.description: action="reverse" only. Port on the host that devicePort forwards to, e.g. 8081 for Metro.

serial.description: Target a specific device (adb -s). Defaults to the sole online device.

tools.name: android_logcat
tools.description: Filtered `adb logcat` crash/debug triage — avoids dumping the full noisy buffer (mostly unrelated GMS/artd/ziparchive lines). Pass tags as `adb` filter specs (e.g. ["AndroidRuntime:E", "ReactNativeJS:*"]) — everything else is silenced (*:S appended automatically) unless a catch-all filter is already present.

tags.description: adb logcat filter specs, e.g. ["AndroidRuntime:E", "ReactNativeJS:*"]. Omit to dump the unfiltered buffer.

sinceClear.description: Clear the log buffer (adb logcat -c) before capturing, so only new lines are returned.

maxLines.description: Keep at most this many of the most recent lines.

serial.description: Target a specific device (adb -s). Defaults to the sole online device.

tools.name: android_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the connected device/emulator (wraps `adb exec-out screencap -p`) and return it inline — the mobile counterpart to browser_screenshot, for the visual before/after evidence the debugging and work-ticket skills require on mobile UI tickets. Saves to {repoRoot}/.screenshots/ unless outputPath is given.

outputPath.description: Absolute path to save the PNG to (default: repo .screenshots/ dir with a timestamped name).

serial.description: Target a specific device (adb -s). Defaults to the sole online device.
